plaatsen.tekst: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before
Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
